# Goal

Inspect and summarize `data/raw/bleach2023SymQpcr.rds`, a qPCR-based dataset
with symbiont genus proportions in corals sampled during and after the 2023
bleaching event.

# Load and Audit

```{r load-data}
raw_qpcr <- readRDS("data/raw/bleach2023SymQpcr.rds") |>
  as_tibble()

glimpse(raw_qpcr)
```

```{r audit-summary}
audit_summary <- tibble(
  n_rows = nrow(raw_qpcr),
  n_columns = ncol(raw_qpcr),
  min_date = min(raw_qpcr$date, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_date = max(raw_qpcr$date, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_species = n_distinct(raw_qpcr$species),
  n_sites = n_distinct(raw_qpcr$siteSimple),
  n_timepoints = n_distinct(raw_qpcr$timepoint),
  n_missing_status = sum(is.na(raw_qpcr$statusSimple)),
  min_prop_sum = min(raw_qpcr$propA + raw_qpcr$propB + raw_qpcr$propC + raw_qpcr$propD),
  max_prop_sum = max(raw_qpcr$propA + raw_qpcr$propB + raw_qpcr$propC + raw_qpcr$propD)
)

audit_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r category-counts}
species_counts <- raw_qpcr |>
  mutate(species_code = str_to_upper(species)) |>
  count(species_code, sort = TRUE)

site_counts <- raw_qpcr |>
  count(siteSimple, sort = TRUE)

timepoint_status_counts <- raw_qpcr |>
  count(timepoint, statusSimple, sort = TRUE)

species_counts |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Samples by species")

site_counts |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Samples by site")

timepoint_status_counts |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Samples by timepoint and bleaching status")
```

# Process Data

```{r process-data}
qpcr_samples <- raw_qpcr |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    sample_id = row_number(),
    species_code = str_to_upper(species),
    status_simple = fct_na_value_to_level(status_simple, level = "Unscored"),
    status_simple = factor(status_simple, levels = c("Healthy", "Bleached", "Recovering", "Unscored")),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("bleach", "recovery")),
    depth_ft = parse_number(as.character(depth_ft)),
    prop_sum = prop_a + prop_b + prop_c + prop_d,
    dominant_clade = c("A", "B", "C", "D")[max.col(as.matrix(pick(prop_a, prop_b, prop_c, prop_d)), ties.method = "first")]
  ) |>
  relocate(sample_id, species_code, date, timepoint, site_simple, status_simple)

qpcr_long <- qpcr_samples |>
  select(
    sample_id, date, species_code, site_simple, status_simple, timepoint,
    dhw, cummaxdhw, total_sym, dominant_clade,
    prop_a, prop_b, prop_c, prop_d
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("prop_"),
    names_to = "clade",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    clade = str_remove(clade, "^prop_") |>
      str_to_upper() |>
      factor(levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D"))
  )

readr::write_csv(qpcr_samples, "data/processed/bleach2023_qpcr_samples.csv")
readr::write_csv(qpcr_long, "data/processed/bleach2023_qpcr_clade_long.csv")
```

# Exploratory Figures

## Sample Coverage

```{r sample-coverage-figure}
species_plot <- species_counts |>
  mutate(species_code = fct_reorder(species_code, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = species_code)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey35") +
  labs(x = "Samples", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic()

timepoint_plot <- qpcr_samples |>
  count(timepoint, status_simple) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = n, fill = status_simple)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Samples", fill = "Status") +
  theme_classic()

species_plot
timepoint_plot

ggsave("outputs/figures/bleach2023_qpcr_species_counts.png", species_plot, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("outputs/figures/bleach2023_qpcr_timepoint_status_counts.png", timepoint_plot, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Symbiont Composition by Species and Timepoint

```{r composition-by-species-timepoint}
composition_species_timepoint <- qpcr_long |>
  group_by(species_code, timepoint, clade) |>
  filter(status_simple == "Healthy") %>%
  summarize(
    n = n_distinct(sample_id),
    mean_proportion = mean(proportion),
    se_proportion = sd(proportion) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

readr::write_csv(
  composition_species_timepoint,
  "data/processed/bleach2023_qpcr_composition_by_species_timepoint.csv"
)

composition_plot <- composition_species_timepoint |>
  filter(species_code %in% species_counts$species_code[species_counts$n >= 15]) |>
  mutate(species_code = fct_reorder(species_code, mean_proportion, .fun = sum)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_proportion, fill = clade)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ species_code) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean symbiont proportion", fill = "Clade") +
  theme_classic()

composition_plot

ggsave("outputs/figures/bleach2023_qpcr_composition_by_species_timepoint.png", composition_plot, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Clade D Across Heat Stress and Bleaching Status

```{r clade-d-dhw-status}
clade_d_plot <- qpcr_samples |>
  filter(species_code %in% species_counts$species_code[species_counts$n >= 15]) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cummaxdhw, y = prop_d, color = status_simple)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.6, color = "grey25") +
  facet_wrap(~ species_code) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Cumulative maximum DHW",
    y = "Clade D proportion",
    color = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

clade_d_plot

ggsave("outputs/figures/bleach2023_qpcr_clade_d_by_dhw_status.png", clade_d_plot, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
